name: exact window value over discrete engine choices
description: out either runs whole on the CPU (4) or merges (0.5, CPU) two GPU halves of 6 each that share the GPU, for 12.5. The optimum is 4. An engine-weighted relaxation proves about 1 (it mixes the two choices); the exact window value proves 4. Treating the GPU halves as parallel would claim the split takes 6.5, still above 4, so the optimum must stay 4.
